profile.formality: Two levels of you: usted (formal) and tú (familiar). Colombians use usted widely, even with friends and family. Vos, used in Argentina and parts of Colombia, is not taught here.
profile.script: Latin with accents (á é í ó ú), ñ and ü. Questions and exclamations open with ¿ and ¡. Spelling follows sound closely.
profile.questionWords: qué, dónde, cuándo, quién, por qué, cómo, cuánto, cuál
profile.agreement: Nouns are masculine or feminine. Adjectives agree in gender and number: encantado / encantada, la película estuvo buena.
profile.conjugation: Verbs change with person. Usted takes the same form as he or she: usted es, tú eres.
profile.wordOrder: Subject–verb–object, as in English, but the subject pronoun is usually dropped: Soy de Medellín.
